grader.scenario: Mobile phone battery degradation query; diagnostic battery test run and authorised repair booking; agent never uses customer name, leaves two silences > 30s, offers zero paraphrasing, asks repeat question about battery life, insults charging habits, and hangs up mid-sentence
grader.notes: The agent ran an over-the-air battery health diagnostic telemetry scan and booked an authorized battery replacement service under manufacturer warranty. However, the agent failed Personalized Call by never addressing the customer by 'Rhiannon', failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [09:15]), failed Paraphrasing by offering zero restatement of the battery failure, failed Active Listening at minute 11 by asking how long the battery lasts on a full charge after Rhiannon explicitly stated in turn 1 that it dies within forty minutes, failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 12 by rudely blaming her charging habits ('If you charge your phone overnight with cheap corner-shop chargers, you only have yourself to blame for ruining the lithium cells'), and failed Confirmed Resolved by abruptly hanging up while Rhiannon was asking follow-up questions.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 42 seconds at [02:30] while querying Knox telemetry, and a second unmanaged silence of 45 seconds at [09:15] while booking repair slot.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never used the customer's name 'Rhiannon' across any turn in the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Agent: 'I completely understand the absolute terror of being stranded on an unlit motorway hard shoulder in the dark and rain when your mobile phone abruptly dies...' - Compassionate acknowledgment of terrifying emergency.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent gave no restatement of customer's rapid battery discharge problem statement, moving directly to server interface.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [11:20] Agent: 'How long does your phone battery typically last on a full charge before dropping to zero?' Customer: 'Gareth, as I told you in my very first sentence, it dies within forty minutes!' - Agent asked for information already given.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [17:40] Agent: 'I will remain the dedicated owner for this repair ticket and ensure the service centre technician logs battery completion tomorrow.' - Clear personal ownership.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [07:45] Agent: 'If you charge your phone overnight with cheap corner-shop chargers, you only have yourself to blame for ruining the lithium cells.' - Unprofessional and blaming customer remark.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [18:20] Agent abruptly ended call while customer was asking about traffic delay rescheduling, cutting her off mid-sentence.
